research_rationale:
Executive Order 13059 (62 FR 44531, August 21, 1997) consolidates the Iran sanctions of Executive Orders 12613, 12957 and 12959: Section 1 bars imports of Iranian-origin goods, Section 2 bars exports, reexports, new investment, dealings and facilitation, Section 3 continues earlier licenses, Section 5 authorizes the Treasury, and Section 7 revokes Executive Order 12613 and parts of Executive Order 12959. The order rests on the national emergency declared in Executive Order 12957, which the held annual notices continue through the notice of March 2, 2026. Pub. L. 109-293 section 101 (2006) keeps the sanctions under Sections 2, 3 and 5 in effect by statute, and 31 CFR part 560 still cites the order as authority. No held instrument revokes, supersedes or ends any section. The order is claimed as in force on 2026-10-14. The notices for 2015, 2016 and 2017 are not held; the later notices and the statute make the gap immaterial to the claim, and it is disclosed here.
Earlier end: Earlier-end test: the order has no own-terms end. The Office of the Federal Register catalog records no revocation of it; the held notes are the order's own revocations of other orders. Executive Orders 13628, 13846 and 14382 recite it among the Iran prohibitions in force and revoke none of it.
Current basis: Current predicate: Pub. L. 109-293 section 101 (held as the note 'Codification of Sanctions Against Iran' to 50 U.S.C. 1701) keeps the sanctions under sections 2, 3 and 5 in effect by statute, and 31 CFR 560.106 and the part 560 authority line (eCFR, amended through 2026-11-06) still cite the order; the bounded searches current-law:usc (2 hits), current-law:ecfr (2 hits) and later-events:ofr_catalog (15 hits: the yearly notices and the order's own revocations of other orders) found no instrument ending any clause.

Later orders that cite it (13628, 13846, 14382) recite it as in force.","independent_command_check":"Section 1 (imports), Section 2 (exports and dealings), Section 3 (licenses) and Section 5 (authority) are separate commands. Executive Orders 13599, 13846 and the statutes impose parallel prohibitions; those are independent and neither end nor replace these clauses.","savings_check":"No clause is claimed ended, so no ended command leaves a residual.","scope_check":"The machine inventory (32 clauses from Section 1 to Section 10(b), with nested items) covers the whole operative text; the repeated numeral scope names (dup2, dup3) are the sub-items of paragraphs 2(b) and 2(d). The opening authority recital and signature are not operative commands."}
